show.description: CROREPATI KA JHADU is a gripping drama about hidden power, betrayal, and redemption. Raghav, a humble janitor in an NGO, secretly carries the past of being the director of one of the world’s biggest finance companies. As conspiracies, family tensions, and corporate rivalries close in, his quiet life unravels—forcing him to reveal his true identity and rise against those who tried to bury him.
